text: This report provides an update of the primary activities and achievements of the Learning and Engagement unit for 2024. Learning and Engagement oversees a wide variety of different programs throughout the year that support key components of the Strategic Plan and further educational goals, including school programs and teacher resources, a roster of public programs for a variety of audiences/ages, virtual experiences, summer camps, and overnight experiences.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo received the report (February 14, 2025) Report from the Senior Director, Strategic Communications and Guest Experience, Toronto Zoo for information.
